title: Move Babulus to dedicated account 869507387405 and cut over babul.us / babulus.anth.us
description:
# Babulus: move to dedicated account 869507387405 (handoff, 2026-10-19)

GOAL: move Babulus Amplify app + backend from the legacy account (335163751677, profile legacy) to the dedicated account 869507387405 (profile chatticus-staging; Ryan is renaming it babulus-production), keeping the private-VPC design, then cut babul.us and babulus.anth.us over and verify the shared footer.

DONE / FINDINGS (2026-10-19)
- Legacy Amplify app d3epcqvzbxdaq (repo AnthusAI/Babulus, WEB_COMPUTE, main). Job 167 got past the ECR conflict (PR #5 references existing ECR repo babulus-render-worker) but FAILED creating RenderWorkerVPC: legacy us-east-1 is at the 5/5 VPC limit and the internet-gateway limit.
- Stack amplify-d3epcqvzbxdaq-main-branch-d63e8b2ffa is ROLLBACK_COMPLETE (empty shell, only a skipped log group). Ryan approved deleting it (2026-10-19 12:03); delete it only if building in legacy again. Do NOT delete the ECR repo babulus-render-worker or its images, and delete nothing else in legacy.
- Account 869507387405 is not empty: Route 53 zones staging.chattic.us and auth-staging.chattic.us, ECR repo chatticuscomputers-computerimage*, CDK bootstrap (CDKToolkit, cdk-hnb659fds-container-assets-*), one VPC. Build alongside; leave them. List them for Ryan later.
- Legacy app config to copy: env AMPLIFY_MONOREPO_APP_ROOT=apps/studio-web, AMPLIFY_DIFF_DEPLOY=false; custom rule /<*> -> /index.html 404-200; build spec: `AWS_PROFILE=legacy aws amplify get-app --app-id d3epcqvzbxdaq --query app.buildSpec --output text` (backend: npm ci; npx ampx pipeline-deploy --branch $AWS_BRANCH --app-id $AWS_APP_ID; frontend appRoot apps/studio-web, artifacts .next).

BLOCKED: the auto-mode permission check denied every write in 869507387405 (iam create-role/attach-role-policy, ecr create-repository). Allow Bash rules for those or approve the prompts. Ryan will connect the GitHub branch in the console himself.

REMAINING STEPS (AWS_PROFILE=chatticus-staging AWS_REGION=us-east-1)
1. aws iam create-role --role-name BabulusAmplifyServiceRole (trust: amplify.amazonaws.com); attach arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmplifyBackendDeployFullAccess.
2. aws ecr create-repository --repository-name babulus-render-worker (backend.ts references it by name).
3. aws amplify create-app --name Babulus --platform WEB_COMPUTE --iam-service-role-arn <role> --environment-variables AMPLIFY_MONOREPO_APP_ROOT=apps/studio-web,AMPLIFY_DIFF_DEPLOY=false --build-spec file://spec --custom-rules ... (no repository). Give Ryan the console link for the single step of connecting the GitHub branch AnthusAI/Babulus main.
4. start-job RELEASE; confirm backend deploys (new account has 1 VPC, room for RenderWorkerVPC).
5. Add the Amplify domain association for babul.us (apex) and babulus.anth.us in the new app.
6. DNS: babul.us zone Z0165124KWWAYOTIZTST in legacy (records: A alias, _060baecdddaae8b156475ba6c53ad277 CNAME) - update A alias and verification CNAME to the new app's values. anth.us zone Z04979341DPRV5BDQNZMG in papyrus-production (profile papyrus-production): update the babulus record. anth.us is the one live site: be careful.
7. Verify https://babul.us and https://babulus.anth.us show the shared footer; then report what is left in legacy for Ryan to decide on.

Also:
- babul.us footer: the shared footer on babul.us goes live only after the Babulus build succeeds (see the Babulus move task).

Source: Claude Code Projects handoff, 2026-10-19.

comments.author: home
comments.text: 2026-10-20: Babulus now runs in 869507387405 (Amplify app d23jak4ewu2gf9, job 2 SUCCEED, no NAT). babulus.anth.us is attached to the new app and serving the new footer. babul.us: AWS refuses the cross-account association (needs AWS Support manual approval), so babul.us is temporarily attached back to legacy app d3epcqvzbxdaq, whose only rule is a 302 to https://babulus.anth.us/<*>. Legacy auto-build disabled. Remaining: Ryan opens the AWS Support case; then detach babul.us from legacy, attach it to d23jak4ewu2gf9, and repoint the babul.us A alias. Lambda concurrency quota increase to 1000 requested (case opened).

comments.author: home
comments.text: 2026-10-20: infra PRs landed on main. #13 (ed5043e) removed the NAT gateway from the render worker network and added trigger guards. #16 (1666cc6) dropped reserved concurrency on the render trigger because new accounts cap Lambda concurrency at 10. A follow-up to restore it after the quota increase is filed separately.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Status 2026-10-23 (pausing for usage throttle). Done: Babulus runs in 869507387405 (Amplify d23jak4ewu2gf9, no NAT); babulus.anth.us is attached to the new app and serves the waitlist (Prospectus intake live), GA4 and consent; legacy auto-build is off. Left: babul.us still 302s to babulus.anth.us via legacy app d3epcqvzbxdaq because AWS requires a Support case for the cross-account Amplify domain association; the Lambda concurrency increase to 1000 is pending at AWS. Next step: either Ryan files the AWS Support case (text drafted in the Babulus session), or babul.us moves to the Papyrus marketing site via its own CloudFront (epic 4f8c94), which avoids the case. Then retire legacy app d3epcqvzbxdaq and the old account's Babulus resources.

right_now_summary: Babulus is being moved to a dedicated AWS account before its domains switch over and the footer is verified.
